findings.title: After Story, Journal or the first-time opening scene the home is a black screen and every tap is swallowed
findings.detail: src/ui/styles/story.css:9 defines a global `.sp { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 300; background: #05060a }` (the scene player's root). It loads with src/ui/story/player.js, journal.js and archive.js. The home's top-bar spacer is h('span.sp') (src/ui/screens/lobby.js:653) and the menu head has another (src/ui/lobby/menuSheet.js:95), so once any story module has loaded, the spacer becomes a full-screen black layer above the whole home, inside .home-top. A first-time player goes title -> opening scene (story CSS loads) -> tutorial -> home, so the very first home they see is black (the beta-gift modal floats over black; after 'Later' only black). It stays until a reload. The same spacer is on feature/ui-v2 5edb7b4c (same result there), so it is inherited, but it ships with this home and its top bar. Live main has no span.sp. ink.css `.ui-topbar .sp` (other v2 top bars) has the same exposure. Fix: give the spacer an unclashing class (for example .ui-spacer) in lobby.js, menuSheet.js and ink.css, or scope story.css's root rule to the player (for example .sp[data-testid="story-player"]). Add an e2e step: open #/story or #/journal, come back, assert elementFromPoint(centre) is inside .home and the Battle plate takes a click.
findings.evidence: branch, 844x390, mid save: #/story then its back arrow -> elementFromPoint(centre) and the plate centre both = span.sp pos=fixed z=300 bg rgb(5,6,10), box 0,0 844x390; page.click(tile-mission) -> '<span class="sp"> from <header ... home-top> subtree intercepts pointer events' (r2/story-black/branch-story-844x390-2-home-after.png). Journal at 1280x720 same, box 1280x720 (r2/story-black/branch-journal-1280x720-2-home-after.png). Fresh save, the real first run (title -> opening Skip -> tutorial Skip -> #/lobby): r2/firstrun/branch-844x390-3-home.png (gift modal over black), r2/firstrun/branch-844x390-4-home-nogift.png (all black); Battle tap timed out. findings.title: Every top-bar redraw leaks a body-wide MutationObserver and two hub listeners; this home redraws the bar on every hub 'badges' event too
findings.detail: buildTop() rebuilds the whole bar on each store change and, new in this layout, on every hub 'badges' event (lobby.js hub.on('badges', ...buildTop), the hub refreshes every 5 min and after any social change). Each build calls chatButton() (src/ui/online/lobbyChat.js), which registers hub.on('badges'), hub.on('status') and a MutationObserver on document.body (subtree). They are released only if that observer once saw the button connected; when the bar is rebuilt in the same task the old button never 'was seen', so its observer and listeners live forever and run on every DOM change anywhere (battle included). The mechanism is pre-existing (base leaks too); this home adds a new redraw trigger. Fix: build the chat button once per home render and update its counts in place, or give buildTop a cleanup that calls the old button's stop(); the lobby's teardown should release it too.
findings.evidence: scripts/leak.mjs at 844x390, mid: start mos=0 hub net {}; after 30 store commits 60 ms apart: mos=28, hub badges 28 / status 28; after 30 more in one task: mos=58, badges 58 / status 58; window/document listeners flat at 48; 6 Students visits add none. Base 5edb7b4c: 14 then 44 (same mechanism).

findings.title: Keyboard focus is thrown to <body> whenever the home redraws: the news pager cannot be pressed twice
findings.detail: pageNews() rebuilds the chip and drawAll() rebuilds every control on each store change, so the focused element is removed. Pressing Enter on the pager turns 1/3 -> 2/3 and focus lands on BODY; a second Enter does nothing, the next Tab starts again at the first control. A store commit while a dock icon has focus also drops focus (and the hub's 5-minute badges redraw drops focus on the bar's buttons). Fix: after a rebuild, focus the new element with the same data-testid when the old one had focus (one helper around buildNews/drawAll/buildTop), or update in place.
findings.evidence: keys1 1280x720 (r2/keys-mid-1280x720.json): pager '1/3 -> 2/3; focus after: BODY', second Enter -> 2/3. keys2 (r2/keys2-1280x720.json): pager focus BODY, secondEnter 2/3; focus on dock-mall + store.commit -> focus BODY.

findings.title: The menu sheet (aria-modal dialog) lets Tab escape to the hidden home behind it, drops focus on close, and its rows ignore Space
findings.detail: Now that Clan, Notice, Hide UI and Background live only in the menu, its keyboard path matters more. (1) No focus containment: Tab after Settings goes to BODY and then into the home controls behind the scrim (chip, pager, icons, CO-OP, Battle, chapter), which are opacity 0 / pointer-events none but still focusable, so a keyboard user can activate an invisible Battle. (2) On close by X, Esc or a tap outside, focus goes to BODY instead of back to the menu button. (3) The rows are <a role="button"> handled by click only, so Space (expected for a button) does nothing; Enter works. Fix: trap Tab inside the sheet while open (or make the rest inert), return focus to top-menu on close, use <button> rows or handle Space.
findings.evidence: keys1 1280x720: menu first focus menu-sheet-close; Tab sequence ... dock-clan, settings, BODY(outside), lobby-objective(BEHIND hidden), lobby-news-next(BEHIND), dock-students(BEHIND) ... tile-mission(BEHIND), lobby-chapter(BEHIND); Space on menu-formation -> still lobby, sheet open; Enter on menu-bestiary -> bestiary; Esc -> focus BODY. keys2: close by x / esc / outside -> focus BODY, next Tab event-card; spaceOnMenuRow {screen: lobby, sheet: true}.

findings.title: Escape does not close the Notice, the Background picker or the login-gift rewards modal on the home
findings.detail: keys.js only handles Escape on screens that opt in ([data-primary] or data-keys="on"); the home does neither, so these dismissable modals stay open on Esc while the menu sheet that opened them closes on Esc. Same on base. Opt the home in with data-keys="on" on its root (its own Space handler already exists) or give these modals onEscape.
findings.evidence: extras 844x390 (r2/extras-mid-844x390.json): Notice closedByEsc=false, Background picker closedByEsc=false, 'Login Day 1' rewards modal closed by Escape: false; keys2 1280x720: esc_notice false, esc_bgpicker false.

findings.title: Space fires Battle while the chat drawer is open
findings.detail: The home's Space handler skips the menu sheet, .modal-overlay and .ui-layer but not the chat drawer (.ol-drawer). With the drawer open and focus on its plain area, Space navigates to Missions. Base had the same guard (it pressed the objective). Add .ol-drawer (or any open drawer) to the guard.

findings.title: Tab order visits the top bar last
findings.detail: DOM order puts .home-ui (chip, icons, CO-OP, plate) before .home-top, so Tab goes chip > pager > 4 icons > CO-OP > Battle > chapter > avatar > gems + > chat > mail > menu, while the eye reads the bar first. Move .home-top before .home-ui in the DOM (z-index already decides the stacking).

findings.title: Gates could not be completed green on this machine; they need one clean run on a quiet machine before merge
findings.detail: npm test, e2e/home.mjs at 1280x720, e2e/smoke.mjs and e2e/hubs.mjs were all disturbed by a load average of 25-61 from other workflows (timeouts, perf budgets, screenshot and 'stable' timeouts, fallback fonts). A clean run of the four on a quiet machine is still owed before merge. Note: neither home.mjs nor smoke.mjs can see B1 (they check the ui-hidden class and the hash, not pixels).
